value: The attunement begins at Baa’ri: a trail of tablets, orders and medallion fragments leads from Shadowmoon toward Akama. Aldor and Scryers receive different opening quests from their own camps; those alternatives later converge. They are not one adventurer’s combined route. The tablets and collection objectives open a path through the valley, but they do not establish that every fragment records a separate historical act.
